# the reports in out/flywheel/reports/ of those lanes (lane/divhistb, 2026-09-28).
# Status checked against master aff2c569: fixes by git merge-base --is-ancestor,
# pins by ls under out/java; clientdraw.allow lines re-run on master's test_snapshots.

column10: repro

column6: a start saved in water replayed an entry splash (86 draws on the player's Random); server_player_load reads inWater from the snapshot
the held stack's attack modifier came from the hand; it comes from the snapshot's Attributes (what the last equipment check applied)
a right click at nothing with an empty hand synced a held slot; it syncs no C09
the Nether's and End's clock is the overworld's (DerivedWorldInfo), so a mob through a portal before the Nether's tick loads its chunks on the right clock (master keeps lane/awaydims' derived clock)
a saved item lost its Thrower and Owner on reload (also pf-endthrower-g1)
an explosion killed arrows, throwables, eyes and primed TNT; they keep Entity.attackEntityFrom and take no damage
EntityAIArrowAttack keeps running at a target that died (master keeps lane/combatscenes' fix)
a Nether or End chunk read back brought items and livings in separate passes; its entities come back in list order (master keeps lane/awaydims' restore; also pf-netherreload-g9)
a mob that picks up an item shares the stack's count with the dead item's reused pool slot (master keeps lane/capacity's slot-owned count; also pf-lootcount-g23)
items and falling blocks did not trip wires or press plates in the entity pass
a flow washing out a tripwire or another circuit block dropped no item
an arrow with no shooter (read back from NBT) is its own damage source: knockback from where it is, no random yaw (master keeps lane/awaydims' version)
the client sent a C08 an ItemBlock cannot place on that side (func_150936_a) (master keeps lane/mobscenes2's ItemBlock precheck)
ItemBlock.onItemUse's entity check included its placer (also pf-placerself-g4; master keeps this skip_placer)
a stronghold start read back from the save links no portal room, so an eye after a rejoin flies to the staircase; the harness writes structures.json Stronghold.portal (also pf-eyetarget-g26)
the dragon's Entity.onEntityUpdate water was missing: flowing water pushes it, an entry splashes on its Random, its Air under water, read back and written
setDead spills the cursor and the 2x2 grid on both sides (master keeps lane/idxclient's; also pf-deathcursor-g12)
a dig finish or abandon that leaves the block answers with its S23; beyond reach the handler returns
the dig manager lives as long as the player: no op ticks it, and a new target keeps an armed finish

the S28 and S24 fan-outs walk playerEntityList, which keeps a dead player (and one past the exit portal) until the respawn; the S27 walks the world's playerEntities (a dead player stays); found once the client fields were compared
a player out of loadedEntityList (dead, or past the exit portal) gets no onUpdate: no chunk sends, and no func_85172_a re-sends of the mobs in them, until the respawn
a client mob copy lost its step counters across ticks; restored from the snapshot's copies, its step on redstone ore runs func_150185_e on the client world (18 WorldClient.rand floats)
a shattering ender eye sent no S28 2003 (the same cause as pf-eyeshatter-g7; master keeps this version)

a warm pool member answered rc 0 for a next-start Snapshot that ran out of heap (Snapshot.parallel wrapped the OutOfMemoryError into an error reply), and was asked --save-at-end runs it always refuses; lane/poolfix makes any Throwable a fault that reruns fresh

the live client drew livings, the dragon, items and orbs from the server's entities; now from its own copies with EntityLivingBase.onEntityUpdate on each (hurt and death clocks from the statuses, prev angles, the S19 head, EntityBodyHelper's body yaw, limbs, ticksExisted), the items' and orbs' own EntityTracker and client updates; 2,775,863 px over 25 to 2,110,423 over the 496 sweep shots

combat.c's tracker did not mark the update block dirty on each kind's DataWatcher values (creeper state, enderman's carried block, zombie flags, witch aggression, potion colour), so Java's hasChanges sent an S19 native did not (an enderman at gold-g10 6498, body yaw 27 degrees off)

the dragon's red hurt pass keeps the lightmap (RenderDragon disables only unit 0's texture) and Entity.getBrightness reads no sky under hasNoSky (the End's hurt flash is black, not red); gold-g30 12500 61,234 px over 25 to 0
handleSpawnExperienceOrb builds the orb at the S11's raw 1/32 fields, so a new orb sits 32 times out until the tracker's first move; the copies' pushOutOfBlocks
paintings, item frames, leash knots and the lead were not drawn by the live client
the client squid keeps the server's yaw; its client turn needs its own Random, not modelled
column10: csrc/tests/frame_judge.sh on a clientframes recording with a squid in view

column6: the Nether drew the overworld: the streamed render records took SR.pop.world's chunk first and the hand, mobs and drops read overworld light; gold-g8 900 64,045 px to 11

fog and vignette too dark in rain: the client subtracted the server's skylightSubtracted, which WorldClient sets only in World's constructor (0 under a sky, 11 in the Nether); gold-g15 11100 208,987 px to 4
surv_client_in_water added 1.62 to the client player's posY, which is the eye already, so no air bubbles or underwater overlay near the surface; gold-g19 9100 98,448 px to 7,234
the live frame drew the translucent terrain before the entities; sortAndRender(1) draws it after the entities, overlays and particles (mobs under water were drawn over it)

the FOV was one tick ahead at every sprint change: updateRenderer runs between the input loops and the living update (the FOV hand, torch flicker, fog brightness, equip animation, clouds); gold-g28 500 106,180 px to 200
the hand dipped after a tool wore down: ItemRenderer's itemToRender is a reference, so the client's in-place wear keeps it; gold-g28 2500
the End drew no near fog (WorldProviderEnd.doesXZShowFog is true); gold-g30 2900 31,286 px to 102

the "Press 'E'" hint toast was never drawn (set at load when the join's S37 held no achievement), and a checkpoint start older than stats.json did not load its save's stats into play's mirrors (old achievements toasted again); gold-g1 100 12,316 px, gold-g7 3500 26,144 to 1,256

livings were drawn at the server's positions, a tick ahead of the client's interpolated copies (a sheep near the camera as a stretched box, standin-s1 499 65,965 px to 3,269); mob equipment and zombie villagers were never drawn live
arrows, fireballs, snowballs, eggs, pearls, eyes, XP bottles, potions, primed TNT, falling blocks and bolts were not drawn live (an arrow was a yellow wireframe box)

the held item's name reset on every damage change (GuiIngame keeps the clock for a damageable item), the HUD update counter was one ahead of Java's (chat fade, heart blink), and an expired toast's clear announced the achievement in chat twice
the dragon drawn at the server's position (its client copy lags up to 3.4 blocks); lane/clientents then drew it from the client's EntityDragon copy
a join snapshot starts with leftClickCounter 10000 (the join screen's setIngameFocus; Java's first row has 9999, play had 0)

setIngameNotInFocus unpresses every binding (KeyBinding.unPressAllKeys, pending presses too); play cleared only held keys and copied the engine's presses back (smoke t=102 forward); the engine now unpresses on an S2D container and the inventory key too
the input block does not run under a container an S2D opened at the tick's start; play's act had it and the engine applied it (a key held while a chest opens moved the player a tick)
GuiScreen.isCtrlKeyDown is control on Linux; play always used command (t4 t=633 want 1 got 0); --mac-keys judges a Mac recording
the client container's player slots were copied from the inventory only inside surv_client_click, so the inventory screen drew empty slots until a click; game-s1 t=729 7,162 px to 314

play interpolated items and orbs from Entity.prev_pos, which the item pool never steps, so every frame between ticks drew every drop near the world origin (0 of 7 drops at pt 0.5); block drops drew as wireframes
the pickup's EntityPickupFX was not drawn (lying still for the S0D's tick, then three ticks toward the player)

GuiContainer's mouseClicked, mouseClickMove, mouseMovedOrUp and keyTyped were not ported: a mouse drag became a one-slot mode-5 op; the pre-lane client failed all four GUI judges (inv tick 32 mode 6 sent as a pickup, wb tick 35 a spurious mode 6, furnace tick 34, chest tick 35)
the screen's drag was not drawn as GuiContainer draws it (each slot's share on a white square, the cursor's remainder, a yellow count at a cap); mid-drag 4,473, 6,334, 11,693 px to 305, 1,214, 2,488
the client's S1F was a no-op (the HUD's XP bar never moved); the preview's skin drew black without steve.rgba; trsel ops did not reach play's tape

once freed list slots were reused, a saved record kept its live instance's list slot after that entity died, and a new entity in the slot was taken for the record's at its unload (gold-g15-s42 row 9901); the record carries the slot's generation

snapshots carried wall-clock values (EntityPlayerMP.field_143005_bX, the keepalive's id and send time, ping) and the manifest's calMonth and calDay were today's date, which native reads for the bat rule and the Halloween pumpkins; the wall-clock fields are written as 0 and the calendar pin (SPEC.md) fixes the date

EntityLivingBase.onDeath passes the killing player's looting modifier to dropFewItems, dropEquipment and the rare-drop roll; native passed 0 (the magma cube's split count was one parent draw short; fight-witherskel-s1's wither skull)

a summoned hostile's tracker entry and S0F are made at its spawn pose (spawnEntityInWorld's addEntityToTracker); native made them on the first tracker pass, so a wither skeleton's re-centred box put its client copy 1/32 off and a pick at the 3.0 reach missed
without generateNether the snapshot leaves out the Nether's region chunks, so a chunk Java loads from disk is generated natively; no later fix found
column10: record a Nether scene from cp-nether-s1 without generateNether true

column6: dev_summon only updated an existing spawner record, so a summoned blaze, ghast or other non-record kind was missing from World.countEntities and the natural spawner placed a five-mob pack Java's cap refused; row 132
a snapshot's saved-chunk EntityArrow reloaded through a fake Det in DET_OTHER, so it took the next id without spending it and its Random and UUID draws never happened (gold-g13 t523, t1995, t2485)
an entity whose chunk unloaded stays alive for whoever holds it (a zombie's villager target); the snapshot wrote only its id, now ghosts.jsonl carries the unlisted livings (gold-g12 t11314)

BiomeGenBase keeps one WorldGenBigTree per biome whose heightLimit is set once and never cleared, so the next big tree of that biome starts from it for the JVM's life; worldstate.nbt carries bigTree (gold-g14 t3466)

ChunkProviderServer's chunksToUnload table only grows; the native rebuilt it fresh, so the save marks' keys landed in other bins and a different 100 chunks unloaded (gold-g16 t3466); a 10-key TreeBin's list order is its history's (gold-g29 t3, cs_restamp f94668b4)
BlockFence's and BlockStairs' bounds are one object's fields the last collision or ray trace left; worldstate.nbt carries blockBounds (gold-g15 t11229, an item pushed out the wrong way)

an enderman's entityToAttack naming the EntityDragon did not resolve (now the End's shadow living, gold-g30 t11367 on); the bind walked the overworld's list with the player in the End, so the dragon's tracker entry started unwatched and its client copy came from a spawn at the server's position (the sword hit missed natively: gold-g30 t2299 and others, endbot-s1)

JDK 8 treeifies a HashMap bin of 9 at 64 bins or more; a ChunkCoordIntPair window does that for 0.17% of player chunks within 300 chunks of the origin at the spawner's r 8, and 29% of those bins hold equal 32-bit hashes whose TreeNode order goes by identityHashCode, which the emulation does not model; a probe over 225 recordings found no such position (lane/longrun later ported the tree bins, not the identity ties)
column10: csrc/tests/order_test.c (make -C csrc order) with equal-hash keys in a treeified bin

column6: ConcurrentHashMap.transfer rebuilds a plain bin's run before lastRun reversed: keys 1, 17, 33, 49, 2..10 put into newSetFromMap(new ConcurrentHashMap()) iterate as 33 1 2 ... 10 17 49 in Java 8, the emulation gives 1 33 ...; no recording is known to reach it
column10: csrc/tests/order_test.c (make -C csrc order) with the keys 1 17 33 49 2..10

column6: the ghast probe's pass read an item its world had already freed; the snapshot runtime's living-reference fields were written as addresses; a mob's equipment and the items sharing its stack linked counts by address into another entity (now pool slots kept until reuse)

play's tape writer printed a float as %.9g, so a look pitch of -0.0 went out as "-0", which the oracle's Gson 2.2.4 reads as the integer 0: at G30 row 4932 Java played pitch +0.0 where play had played -0.0; a tape float now always has a point

a silverfish out of a monster egg (the player's break, an ally's summon) did not join the natural spawner's count and boxes; at row 2704 Java counted 80 against the cap of 79 and skipped the pass while native spawned
World.getClosestVulnerablePlayer shrinks its range to 0.8 for a sneaking player (the server player's C0B flag); native still gave a silverfish the target at 7.27 blocks, row 3094

the replay's player twin started in the overworld whatever the checkpoint's dimension, so from an End start an enderman's canEntityBeSeen traced through the overworld and loaded its chunk (0, -3) at row 3856, drawing the End's Random differently
EntityPlayer.func_146097_a's look-direction throw spreads its item by StrictMath.cos and sin (fdlibm); libm's cos was an ulp off at gold-g19 row 84
the server player's hunger and saturation effects perform before PotionEffect.onUpdate decrements; the port lost the last tick of a rotten flesh's hunger (gold-g19)
EntitySlime.readEntityFromNBT's setSlimeSize(Size + 1) on a chunk load; the native kept the constructor's random size box and a tiny slime suffocated on its first tick (gold-g24)
EntitySkeleton's setCombatTask after super's Equipment read on the region load path; a bow skeleton from a saved chunk kept the melee task and looked nowhere (gold-g24 row 2384)

the spawner's count class of a reloaded villager or golem was left at 0 (SP_ZOMBIE) by a designated-initializer table, so after the 900-tick save six reloaded villagers filled the monster cap and the monster pass was skipped (gold-g24 row 2705)

ItemFood.onFoodEaten adds its effect only when world.rand.nextFloat() is under the item's probability (raw chicken 0.3, rotten flesh 0.8); the port took the draw and added the effect every time (gold-g25)
the region load path did not drop a saved motion component over 10 as Entity.readFromNBT does (an animal came back at gold-g26 row 8101 with motion 26.7 and -17.5)

EntityItem.onCollideWithPlayer's addItemStackToInventory shrinks the stack in place even when it returns false; a thrown 64 cobblestone gave 59 to a slot and kept 5, where native wrote the count back only on true (gold-g27)

at the first keyframe some chunks' inhabitedTime was Java's minus (start tick - 1), and a playerless world's updateEntityTick was not advanced natively while its entity list was empty (the state diff notes it as drift; no row carries either)
column10: test_snapshots --keyframe --state-diff on a recording with keyframes (lane/keyframes)

column6: gold-g14 keyframes 2002 to 11002 did not resume: 39 leaf cells Java clears at 3189; lane/leavesfire's per-leaf-block decay centre in worldstate.nbt leafDecay is the likely fix (the old keyframes carry none), not re-checked here

play's own copy of the snapshot session fell behind the replay gate's: keepInventory passed as 0 (death-keepinv-s1 w.ents 100/101 at row 128), no weather or difficulty after the world tick, trsel ops dropped, window -1 clicks kept; one session.c for both

the client copy of the dragon was missing (pickobj.c: its tracker entry, range 80 and frequency 3, the S0F, moves, health, the client's onLivingUpdate), so the pick could not list its parts; the client's attack on a part and the server's C02 on a part (no crit, no enchantment, no damageDealt stat); a bow released in the same tick as a hotbar switch still fires

the dragon's entry update block runs on isAirBorne (knockBack and addVelocity set it); the wing push and bite reach only mobs filed in the searched chunk sections; the collision push lands at its place in the query's chunk order; drops of a mob the bite kills join the pass

an EntityDragon unloaded with its chunk stays alive and frozen as the endermen's target while a reload is a new dragon; arrows in an unloading End chunk are saved and come back in chunk order; a reloaded arrow's unregistered inTile reads as air; a reloaded mob keeps only its saved attribute modifiers

items and XP orbs falling into the exit portal travel to the overworld spawn (8 times x and z for the old one, a new one at the spawn's top block); outOfWorld damage is not absolute, so it draws the enchantment roll (118dc55c)

BlockEndPortalFrame's collision boxes (13/16 base and the eye) were a full cube, so the player stood on the frame a tick too long and entered the End a row late; World.updateEntities removes a dead entity whose update the chunk guard skips; a chest a population step replaces spills its contents; each BlockStairs object's shared bounds are the full cube after addCollisionBoxesToList and octant 7 after collisionRayTrace (an XP orb pushed the wrong way)

a snapshot at an arbitrary tick did not resume: entity runtime fields and AI state, the players' sprint, sneak, potions, mount and handler state, the client's pending packets, the chunk stream, tracker entries, open windows, the dig controller, tile entity runtime, each world's Teleporter, leashes, primed TNT, fireballs; 53 of 495 ticks before, 55 of 55 on 40 recordings after

native bugs the sweep found: a zombie's CanBreakDoors from NBT lacked its task, the held weapon's modifier on an NBT restore, a slime from region NBT skipped setSlimeSize, item merging missed the other item list of a world, an onSpawnWithEgg spawning a chicken wrote through a record pointer the array growth had moved, the region store context set inside an entity tick

the replay's player living did not carry the server player's yaw and pitch, so EntityEnderman.shouldAttackPlayer's getLook never turned an enderman natively (gold-g10); the twin kept the overworld as its world after a dimension change (end-exit-s1, 30c14eae)
Chunk.func_150809_p's getChunkFromBlockCoords for the east and south neighbours loads a chunk that is not loaded; a chicken reloaded from its chunk keeps the constructor's fresh egg timer (gold-g10)

a region section with no block (a light write allocated it) is read back allocated and counts for getTopFilledSegment; an entity a spawn candidate's chunk load brings joins the pass ahead of the candidate; an arrow in an unloading chunk is saved and comes back; the witch ages by EntityMob's brightness rule; the dig drive's air check loaded a long-finished target's chunk; the snapshot records each EntityTrackerEntry (gold-g11)

the spawner read the WorldInfo thunder flag, not World.isThundering (the weighted strength over 0.9); a structure start restored from structures.json lost its components' once-set generation flags; the navigator matched the abstract BlockBasePressurePlate by class name, so real plates blocked a villager's path (gold-g12)

a chest's unsaved state (neighbour scan, counters, viewers, lids) rescanned natively and loaded a chunk (458c0eb7); a plant popped inside an entity's update draws on the entity pass's World.rand; isPlayerWatchingThisChunk requires the chunk to have left the send queue and func_85172_a retries an S26 bulk's entities; client mobs in liquids move by the liquid branches; updateFallState asks the squid's own isInWater (gold-g13)

a living's Entity.isWet did not count rain (an enderman's rain damage, gold-g14), nor did moveEntity's (a burning skeleton fizzes out in rain, gold-g15); a mob read back from a saved chunk drops a motion component over 10 (dbf91078)

should_side_be_rendered lacked BlockBreakable.shouldSideBeRendered's glass branch: glass and stained glass draw a face against another metadata and hide it against their own; without it 720 to 11,315 px

the client state that changes a frame was not ported: getFOVMultiplier (flying, movementSpeed, the bow's draw squared), the portal timer and its portal.trigger draw, handleHealthUpdate's hurt fields, the client lightning bolt and lastLightningBolt; negative controls 17,689 to 344,909 px
renderstate.c's getSkyColor thunder mix blended toward the thunder strength instead of the grey (0.75 too bright at full thunder)

WorldRenderer's inside draw (a render-type-0 block drawn again from inside when it is the view block) stays in its section until the next rebuild, so walking out of a portal keeps the extra faces; native drew from the camera block (cs_portal out-of-portal views 1,272 to 12,580 px, now 8 to 51)

the native client world kept the server's light where ChunkProviderClient's recheckGaps and the client's relights run their own; lane/idxclient later gave the client world its own light (on tapes made under the light pin)

tile-entity renderers were not ported (chests and lids, ender chests, signs, skulls, the spawner's mob, the End portal's sixteen layers); the spawner display's head yaw varied run to run with the tile-entity HashSet order (later the spawner display pin)

entity render passes were missing or wrong: the lightmap texture is GL_CLAMP with linear filtering (the eyes passes read half the block-15 texel through the border: mobs2a_spider 173 to 2 px), the charged creeper's armour is GL_ONE, GL_ONE with depth writes off (1,088 to 136), eye-pass hurt overlays add twice, the biped legs' pivot, the witch's nose offsets, stacked block item copies, the glint colour left set

llvmpipe's second passes over the same geometry (the TNT flash, the glints, the hurt overlay) z-fight in bands a depth-exact model of its vertex and setup math would need (ent_tnt t70, t77, t78 at 637 to 3,214 px); held by render budgets
the slime's outer-layer hurt flash and the saddle's are not drawn (the skull helmet and falling anvil and egg variants were later drawn by lane/idxclient); no later fix found

column6: the GUI block icon used sin 210 = +0.5, drawing every block icon mirrored through its rotated z and lit as if turned away (blockicons_hotbar_a 2,781 to 222 px), and a tinted block item clamped the light instead of the lit colour; GuiFurnace's flame was over 12, not 13; the section sign counted as a glyph (the boss name 3 px off)
a ScreenSetup command's packets were not drained before the next tick, so one replay in three diverged at a flying toggle; now drained in the recording and its replay

the translucent terrain pass ran before the entities and particles (particles behind the portal on top, 302 to 409 px, now 14); getBrightnessForRender used isOpaqueCube where World uses useNeighborBrightness (wrong inside obsidian and lava); the old live constructor drew one seeder long too many; dig particles' UVs run corner u0 first

the stars (renderStars' Random(10842L) list), the animated atlas sprites, the clock and compass dials, item frames and updateTorchFlicker were not drawn; without the patch the liquids views 3,589 to 3,873 px, anim_dials 7,046, sky_night 471
a snapshot did not carry the live VillageCollection (villages, door counters, aggressors, the siege) nor each villager's and golem's village; native started empty
a structure start read back from data/<Type>.dat keeps each component's box, HPos and VCount; native rebuilt it from the seed (the x 663 house at HPos 66 instead of 68, row 23)

reputation, aggressors, zombie infection (NORMAL nextBoolean, HARD always) and the golden-apple cure were not ported; villagers and golems counted as monsters in the spawner's cap; the door scan's chunk generation reseeds World.rand (dropped); the spawner kept the start difficulty after a dev change; a restored entity pushed into the order twice (use after free)
the siege ran before VillageCollection.tick and skipped func_75529_b's muster draws ((int) truncation included); native failed at row 1156 without them
native path following misses Java's direct-path shortcut past a village door (seen in a siege try, row 1217); no later fix found

lane/suitestart's build-at-first-load ran the seed world's build inside a tick and left randomtick's Det and World.rand pointing at the build's dead locals, so a lava spring's fizz right after drew Math.random into nothing

a bat hit while hanging un-hangs (EntityBat.attackEntityFrom); checkpoint region entities keep their Riding chain and IsChickenJockey; a moved saved chunk keeps its tile entity registry (a use after free); the join's S06 in flight (gold-g8)

the autosave marks run after the network tick; the away overworld's player manager takes the view distance (5f4d1b6c); a moved item follows its chunk in the living world's lists (015e68a5); a snapshot without lastHealth reads as a fresh player (12be1c30) (gold-g9)

no door and no crop was ever placed natively: survival.c sent ItemDoor, ItemSeeds and ItemSeedFood to itemuse.c's on_item_use, which has no case for them, on the server and the client; place.c's item_door_on_item_use and item_seeds_on_item_use now take them; row 24 (also cov-seeds-s1)

the client light check (setActivePlayerChunksAndCheckLight's func_147451_t) ran at no cell natively; it runs at the cell WorldClient.rand picks, recovered from the rows' d.cw (with the check off the client section hashes differ from tick 260); the client world keeps its own light (the flush, recheckGaps, the relight rotation)

the spawner's display mob draws its constructor's three Math.random on the RENDER role's stream, so its head turn depended on every earlier frame's draws; the spawner display pin (SPEC.md) reseeds them per construction, and the client spawner is made by the S35 after its block
